items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he played with Fletcher Henderson a long time.

ctx.x: Yes, he played with Fletcher Henderson a long time. He was a very good drummer. Smooth. He wasn't a loud drummer. He was a great cymbal man. He used to do a lot of work on the hi-hat cymbal. It was something special. He'd drive the Fletcher Henderson band.

And they had some very good drummers during that time, very good. Cozy Cole was a great tom-tom man. He loved to play tom-toms. He liked to play cymbals, too. In fact, he gave me a cymbal that was too large for him because he...
